name: mpy-debugpy
description: One-keypress MicroPython debugging: runs `mpremote debug` and attaches VS Code's Python debugger to the on-target debugpy server.

target.description: Name from mpdebug.toml, 'unix', or an mpremote connect string; omitted to use the config's sole target.

program.description: module[:method] to run under the debugger; default is the target's own 'program', or 'target:main'.

port.description: TCP port for the on-target debug server; default is the device's own default.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the device to report its debug-server endpoint.

dapLog.description: Log DAP traffic to a JSONL file via a local proxy.

dapLogFile.description: Path for --dap-log's JSONL output; requires dapLog.

cwd.description: Working directory to spawn `mpremote debug` in; also the local/remote pathMappings root for a unix target.

mpremotePath.description: Path to the mpremote executable; default resolves it from PATH.

mpremoteArgs.description: Arguments before 'debug', so mpremotePath can be an interpreter - e.g. ["-m", "mpremote"] with mpremotePath "python3" to run a source checkout.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the spawned `mpremote debug` process (merged over the inherited environment).

configurationSnippets.label: MicroPython: Debug
configurationSnippets.description: Debug a MicroPython script: spawns `mpremote debug` and attaches VS Code's Python debugger.
